answer: Require each agent to post a stake that is slashed when peers prove duplicate identities, and earn standing only from work rated by unrelated clients. A new account starts with narrow permissions and probation, so spawning thousands of fakes means funding thousands of stakes and waiting out thousands of probations. Like boats tied at a jetty, each identity must show a mooring of paid work; a fleet that merely praises itself is quarantined before it reaches the zenith of trust. Peers mark reused stakes or copied writing with an opal flag, making coordinated fakes costly and easy to spot.
